snippet.title: Moon & The Fractured Reincarnation Teaser Trailer: The World is Changing. . .
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3614050/Moon__The_Fractured_Reincarnation/

The Moon Goddess... seemingly distraught, tears apart a barrier between worlds, causing planes to appear in different dimensions and realities entirely - while doing so she unleashes her Celestial Beings, causing the human plane to further mutate as magik from wilted realms seep into Midgard. The world today.. now exists as a cohesion between a new kind of normalcy - willfully forged, and post-apocalyptic dead-zones that humans have foregone due to strong manifestations of Celestial Magik...

From time to time, Towers seem to appear out of nowhere.. those who wander into them are usually never seen or heard of again...these spaces have come to be known as Dungeons.

Dungeons, are typically only tested and tried by those known as " Scavengers" , "Wasties", or what the Goddess may deem them herself...

"Moonlit Vassals."
